detail.longDescription: Today I am giving some love to AppImage. Released libfuse2-compat so AppImage(s) still using the very,very,very,very,very old type-2 runtime... can still work without having the user to install a high-deprecated-unstable-broken libfuse2 lib in their system =) https:// github.com/mirkobrombin/libfus e2-compat What it does is simply translating fuse2 calls to fuse3. So yes, you need fuse3 installed. # Linux # OpenSource # Development
